d:
Vikas ke davon aur behtar sarak vyavastha ki baton ke bich bihar ke munger men jamalpur prakhand ki indrukh pashchim panchayat antargat vard sankhya-4 ke aadampur ganv ki tasvir sarkari vyavastha ki jamini hakikat bayan kar rahi hai.yahan enaech-80 se munger, patna aur bhagalpur sahit halimpur, gauripur aur darjanon ganvon ko jorne vali mukhy sarak pichhle karib do varshon se badhali ka dansh jhel rahi hai.
